title: Explain a Shared Project
instructions: Read and record the model. Then record your own answer using different details.
prompt: Describe a real or imagined project that you do with another person. Explain the design, materials and tools, how you share the work, one possible mistake, and what to do before finishing. Speak for about 75–105 seconds. Use quantity expressions and explain at least two steps in order.
reference: I want to make a welcome picture with my friend. There is some paper and blue paint in our studio, but there are only two brushes. First, we make a sketch and arrange the shapes. We put a circle in the middle and a triangle at the top. We share the tools and take turns painting. If we make a small mistake, we can use spare paper to cover it. Before we move the picture, we wait for the paint to become dry. While we wait, we return the borrowed ruler and put our tools away. Working together helps us finish carefully.
